name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=inventory (UI subsystem), descriptor=grid_input_step (processes one frame/keystroke of inventory-grid selection). No Ghidra address residue; '8'/'4' constants in body are the 8-slot inventory and 4-item row stride (semantic, not address). Name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Process one keystroke of inventory-grid selection input: redraw char_idx's 8-slot inventory grid to VRAM with the cursor highlighted, count active slots, wait for a key, and either move the cursor (return 0), commit the selection (return 1), or cancel (return -1).
logic_summary: active_count=0; fd2_render_inventory_item_grid(char_idx, data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx, 0xA0000). Count active slots: for slot 0..7, if (inventory_slots[slot*2] & 0x80)==0 -> active_count++. scancode = fd2_wait_for_input_dialog_with_blink(0). Dispatch on scancode: 0x48 Up: cursor!=0 -> cursor--,SFX0,return 0; cursor==0 -> cursor=active_count-1 (wrap),SFX0,fall to return 0. 0x50 Down: cursor!=active_count-1 -> cursor++,SFX0,return 0; else cursor=0,SFX0,fall to return 0. 0x4B Left: cursor>=4 -> cursor-=4,SFX0,return 0; else no-op return 0. 0x4D Right: cursor<4 && cursor<active_count-4 -> cursor+=4,SFX0,return 0; else no-op return 0. 0x1C/0x39 Enter/Space: if require_usable!=0, look up fd2_get_item_effect_entry(slot[cursor].item_id) and require entry[0xD]!=0 (has a use-effect) else return 0 (re-prompt); return 1 (commit, chosen slot in data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx). 0x01 Esc: return -1. Any other key: return 0 (loop again).

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr selecting the character whose 8-slot inventory grid is rendered/scanned (e.g. inventory_slots[slot*2], slot item id at [cursor*2+1]).
params.reason: Accurately names the runtime_char array index; no address residue.

params.name: require_usable
params.semantics: Gate flag forwarded from the caller. When non-zero, an Enter/Space commit is accepted only if the selected item has a use-effect (fd2_get_item_effect_entry(item_id)[0xD] != 0), else the input re-prompts (return 0). When zero, any occupied slot may be confirmed. Callers: =1 for the item 'use' command (must have use-effect); =0 for swap/give/sort/equip.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name 'require_usable' precisely describes the gating semantics (commit requires a usable item when set) and carries no address residue. NOTE: the src/ definition currently spells this parameter 'gate_flag'; that src/Ghidra parameter-name drift is a Stage 2 rename concern (per the rule param renames are applied in Stage 2 across protos.h/call sites) and is not modified here. The current (live Ghidra) name is correct -> keep.

returns.semantics: 0 = still in grid (cursor moved or invalid/other key; caller loops); 1 = slot committed (chosen slot index left in data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx); -1 = Esc cancel.

notes: Both function name and comment are already correct and precise; no src edit and no Ghidra plate change needed. src comment (status.c lines 823-852) matches the decompilation behavior exactly (verified clause-by-clause: Up/Down wrap, Left/Right row stride 4, Enter/Space use-effect gate via entry[0xD], Esc=-1, SFX 0 on accepted moves). Live Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with this understanding -> left untouched. Parameter-name drift between live Ghidra ('require_usable') and src ('gate_flag') noted under params[1]; deferred to Stage 2 rename (not changed here). Faithful-binary note (not a bug, not recorded as an issue): if active_count==0 the Up-wrap computes active_count-1 = 0xFFFFFFFF, but callers gate entry on fd2_count_usable_inventory_slots != 0 so the grid is never opened empty; behavior is identical to the binary. status.c was clean before this run and was not edited; only the shard file is staged/committed (other dirty shard files belong to concurrent refiners and were left untouched).
